Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl

Class VersionSelectResourceResolver

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.AbstractStagingResourceResolver
      • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.VersionSelectResourceResolver
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable, org.apache.sling.api.adapter.Adaptable, org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver
    public class VersionSelectResourceResolver
extends AbstractStagingResourceResolver
    A unmodifiable ResourceResolver for which one can specify specific versions of "mix:versionable" which are presented as if that was the current content. (Unmodifiable in the sense that no content can be modified through it.
